title: They said you’re not a pastor… because you don’t have a building.
paragraphs: They said you’re not a pastor… because you don’t have a building.
Because deep down, it stings more than you admit.
You didn’t say it out loud…
You stay up late answering questions no one else sees.
But because it’s not inside four walls—
We’ve been trained to see platforms as proof…
So let me ask you something that cuts deeper than titles:

Who is bleeding for souls—
the one with the building…
or the one with the burden?
“Be shepherds of God’s flock that is under your care…” (1 Peter 5:2)
But here’s where it gets uncomfortable.
And when you actually guide them…
and still not be a shepherd.
and still not carry a soul.
The kind no one claps for.
Because the real danger is not that you don’t have a title.
The danger is that you might start needing one to feel legitimate.
That’s where pride sneaks in quietly.
No official title given by men.
Isaiah said He would be “despised and rejected” (Isaiah 53:3).
He carried the weight of every soul.

God does not validate your calling through architecture.
He validates it through assignment.
They become so focused on being “right”…
that they forget to be redeemed.

Do your people feel safe enough to confess sin…
or only safe when they sound spiritual?
“Be crucified with Christ and made new.”
Paul said in Galatians 2:20 that he had been crucified with Christ and no longer lived, but Christ lived in him.

If your identity is shaken by people questioning your title…
then somewhere inside, title still matters more than you think.
Because Jesus didn’t die so you could be called “pastor.”
He died so you could be made new.
Romans 3:23 says all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.
That includes the one with the building.
And the one with the GC.
And salvation is not through position.
Ephesians 2:8–9 reminds us that we are saved by grace through faith—not by works, so no one can boast.
the only name that saves you—

Some people are more offended by lack of title
than by lack of transformation.
You are not defined by what people call you.
You are defined by who you belong to.
You are not trying to prove a role.
You are responding to a call.
And if God entrusted people to your care—
is the moment you stop growing.
Grace is not just what saved you.

“Lord… if You remove every title…
will I still serve the same way?”
And if you want to go deeper—
If this pierced your heart, don’t ignore it.
If this stirred something in you…
There’s more coming that might answer the questions you haven’t even asked yet.
